description: Research brief with cited sources on any topic, written to order (not instant). Returns a job id and due time right away; the finished brief (title, summary, markdown body, source links, word count) is ready within 24 hours, usually the same day, at GET /v1/jobs/:id, which is free. About 500 words by default (50-1500 via max_words), with at least 3 cited public web sources. Price: $0.25 USDC per call (x402 on Base) or 1 prepaid pack credit. Failed calls aren't charged when you pay per call with x402: if the job errors, the USDC payment is never settled. With pack credits (X-Entitlement-Key), a call that fails gives its credit back.
name: brief
title: Brief ($0.25)
